# Quadrant Health Group

> Quadrant Health Group is a national network of licensed addiction and mental health treatment centers offering detox, residential, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient and virtual care.

This site describes the network, its levels of care, its facilities (listed under Locations) and the team behind them. Each facility also has its own website, linked from its location page. Admissions: (888) 970-6234, available 24/7. Head office: 5201 Congress Ave, Suite 275, Boca Raton, FL 33487.

All URLs below are canonical. Medical content is reviewed under the editorial policy at https://www.quadranthealthgroup.com/editorial-policy/.
